observations: A dual-compartment plastic pedal waste bin with green and grey sections.
Each compartment has a lid with a metal hinge and a pedal at the base for foot operation.
The green side is labeled 'Kitchen waste' with Chinese characters '厨余垃圾' and an icon of food scraps.
The grey side is labeled 'Other waste' with Chinese characters '其他垃圾' and a recycling symbol.
The bin appears to be made of molded plastic, with a dark grey base and frame.
The pedal is visible at the front bottom, with a textured surface for grip.
The bin is shown in two different settings: on a blue rubber mat (photo 0) and on artificial grass (photo 1).
No brand or model name is visible on the bin in either photo.
The seller's watermark 'SKYVILLA BATHS & KITCHENS' is overlaid on both photos.
